bio: Offering Asian-fusion cuisine and an exotic cocktail selection, Sunset by Australasia is an indulgent retreat in the heart of the city with a décor that transports you to faraway shores.  The Sunset menu features exotic afternoon teas, delicious small plates, sushi and robata grill favourites as well as individual Bento Boxes and an indulgent dessert sharing selection. Sunset all day dining is available from noon until 8pm.  The unique Sunset Afternoon Tea packages are available from Monday to Sunday from 12pm until 5pm.
